name: MAST Portal API and TESScut (TESS, Kepler, Hubble, JWST)
summary: Search observations from TESS, Kepler/K2, Hubble, JWST and other missions through the MAST Portal API, and find or download TESS full-frame cutouts with TESScut; free, no key for public data.
description: The MAST Portal API (api/v0/invoke) wraps services such as Mast.Caom.Cone, Mast.Caom.Filtered, Mast.Caom.Products, Mast.Name.Lookup and the TESS Input Catalog cone searches, returning JSON by default. TESScut (tesscut/api/v0.1) reports which TESS sectors, cameras and CCDs cover a sky position and cuts pixel stamps from the TESS full-frame images as FITS files. A TESScut sector lookup at RA 350.251, Dec -4.015 returned 3 sectors on 2026-11-13.

auth.notes: Public data need no credential; exclusive-access data can be retrieved only by authenticated, authorized users.

rate_limit.summary: TESScut limits each user to no more than 5 requests per second and answers 503 beyond that (documented). The Portal API documents no request rate, only a 10 minute inactivity timeout for a query.

endpoints.summary: TESS sectors, cameras and CCDs covering a position or a moving target
Download TESS full-frame-image cutouts (FITS) for a position; area limit 10,000 pixels
Portal API: request is a JSON document naming a service (for example Mast.Caom.Cone with ra, dec, radius), plus format, page and pagesize

license.name: Mostly public domain (CC0 under NASA policy); community HLSPs CC BY 4.0; DSS and GSC CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Acknowledge mission and MAST.

coverage.temporal: Mission archives from TESS, Kepler/K2, Hubble, JWST and others

agent_notes: Use the TESScut sector call to learn whether TESS observed a position; it is fast and tiny. The Portal API takes a URL-encoded JSON request, for example {"service":"Mast.Caom.Cone","params":{"ra":350.251,"dec":-4.015,"radius":0.005},"format":"json","pagesize":2,"page":1}; keep radius small and pagesize low. Mast.Name.Lookup resolves an object name to coordinates and Mast.Caom.Products lists the downloadable files for an obsid. The mission acknowledgement texts for TESS and Kepler/K2 are on the MAST mission-acknowledgements page.
caveats: No Access-Control-Allow-Origin header was sent by TESScut or the catalog hosts, so browsers on other origins cannot call it directly.

A Mast.Caom.Cone request with radius 0.005 degrees around RA 350.251, Dec -4.015 returned 200 but took 22 s on 2026-11-13, so it is not used as the example (bin/verify.php gives up at 15 s); the page size did not shorten it.
TESScut returns a sector entry per camera and CCD, so a position can list several entries for the same sector.
Since August 2025 TESScut no longer makes cutouts from TICA full-frame images; SPOC full-frame images remain.

verification.notes: Exact example request executed without credentials.
